0022600223.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 3-3 at home, 1-3 on the road) have lost their last two games and sit 11th in the West, 4 games back in the Southwest, while the Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-3 at home, 1-5 on the road) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 13th in the East. The Pelicans will be without Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Zion Williamson (rest), and the Nets will be without Egor Demin (leg bruise), while Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Pelicans winning the most recent meeting 116-113 in New Orleans.
